title: FieldDefinition
description: Field definition for creating or updating custom fields

displayName.description: The human-readable name of the field

valueType.description: The data type of the field. Valid values are string, boolean, date, datetime, singleSelect, multiSelect, int, float, reference

required.description: Indicates if the field is required

unique.description: Indicates if the field must be unique across all records

indexed.description: Indicates if the field should be indexed for faster search
